summary: All plan items implemented and verified. The execution_flow.py commit-failure handler falls through to the rev-list check when _is_nothing_to_commit matches, preserving real-error behavior. The _is_nothing_to_commit predicate uses the full three-pattern regex. All five planned tests are implemented and passing: (1) nothing-to-commit + ahead proceeds, (2) nothing-to-commit + not ahead fails as agent_failure, (3) empty staged + not ahead fails as agent_failure, (4) nothing-to-commit + orphan history is reattached, (5) classifier unit tests for _is_nothing_to_commit cover benign patterns and reject real errors. Lint and type checks pass on changed files. Validation doc exists at plans/ISSUE_327_VALIDATION.md documenting iteration-1 gap closures.
